newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco eyes sale of screen printing unit.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco eyes sale of screen printing unit.

text.p: Sonoco Products Company said Wednesday it retained J.P. Morgan & Co Inc to investigate a possible sale of its screen printing unit, in order to focus on its core packaging business.

"Although the screen printing division is a highly respected leader in its business sector with good earnings and sound management, the industry in which it participates is printing and not packaging," Sonoco President and Chief Executive Officer Peter Browning said in a statement.
Browning said a divestiture would allow the screen printing division to focus on printing, and Sonoco to focus on packaging.
The screen printing operations are located in Hillside, N.J. and Knoxville, Tenn., and became part of Sonoco with its 1993 acquisition of Engraph Inc, it said.
